confusions: The seal-vs-open choice felt like a parallel decision that needed clearer early telegraphing. The reeve and gray priest both wanted opposite things, but it took talking to both of them to realize this was a binary choice with real consequences.
The strongbox in the barrow antechamber (east passage) was never explored or explained—unclear if it was important or just optional flavor.

The two paths (verses vs crown) diverge significantly, but the game doesn't make it clear early that collecting verses leads to one experience while pursuing the crown leads to a fundamentally different one.
suggestions: Telegraph the seal-vs-open choice more clearly upfront—maybe have NPCs mention both factions exist before the player reaches the barrow.
Add explicit descriptions of what the crown path requires (proof of grief or a token) when the elder first mentions the coffer, not just when asked directly.
Include a hint or explanation for locked side rooms (strongbox, crypt) so players know whether they're essential or truly optional.
Consider a scout-specific action to identify which path (verses or crown) is more achievable based on discovered items/information.
